programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: Meteor is a disaster mini-series about a meteor on a collision course with Earth. After NASA discovers a giant meteor named Kassandra that threatens to erase humanity of the planet, astronomer Dr. Lehman and his assistant Imogene O'Neil must hurry to collect information about it. Lehman tragically dies along the way. Meanwhile, meteor showers are occurring worldwide causing panic. One of the towns hit by the meteorites is Taft in California. There, detective Jack Crowe is tries to find his ex partner Stark before he kills his daughter and father who is the sheriff of the town.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Attack of the 5ft. 2 Woman
programme.desc: Julie Brown stars in two media satires as figure skater Tonya Hardly and as angry wife Lenora Babbitt.

programme.title: Close Up
programme.desc: Exploring the lives and careers of the well-known and famous from the worlds of music and film, these 26-minute long biographical portraits provide a pictorial insight into the background, careers and personal lives of some of the twentieth-century's best known personalities and iconic faces.

programme.title: Murder 101
programme.desc: Mystery thriller starring Dick Van Dyke with his son and grandson. A retired criminology professor teams up with a private eye to investigate the kidnap of a champion race horse which turns into a complicated case of murder and fraud. After the ransom demand is met, the trainer is found dead in a barn fire and the horse's owner comes under suspicion.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: David Robinson is being shipped off to a penal colony. His wife and kids are allowed to accompany him. A storm strikes the ship and the family (save for one son, Jacob) are trapped below deck. Jacob is raised by pirates, and the family gets out of the boat and on to land, salvaging as much as they can from the boat, including dogs, chickens, and muskets. They learn to survive and build a shelter on land. Then, Jacob's pirates kidnap Emily, the daughter of a sea-captain. She escapes onto the island and becomes a love interest with Fritz and Ernst. Jacob is reunited with his family during a battle with the pirates over Emily, and she is returned to her father. In the end, the family goes their own ways, some staying on the island, some going home.

programme.title: McBride
programme.desc: Mystery drama. A cop-turned-lawyer with a penchant for lost causes defends a disc jockey whose universally loathed radio partner is shot dead. It seems an open-and-shut case for the police, but the maverick attorney finds that there is more to the case than initially meets the eye.

programme.title: McBride
programme.desc: Kukla, Fran and Ollie is an early American television show using puppets, originally created for children but soon watched by more adults than children. It did not have a script and was entirely ad-libbed.

programme.title: Farscape: The Peacekeeper Wars
programme.desc: American science fiction series centering on human astronaut John Crichton as the fate of the Peacekeeper race rests on his shoulders. Brought back by the Peacekeeper Alliance, Crichton is their last hope when a monstrous war is waged by the sinister Scarran Empire, and the resilient astronaut must do all he can to protect the people from being destroyed, and the universe from being consumed by the plans of the evil empire. The two-part series follows on from the original Farscape series which, after its cancellation, was left needing to be brought to a conclusion.

programme.title: The Maldonado Miracle
programme.desc: Family drama with Peter Fonda. In a small, dying town, the residents' faith is tested when a statue of Jesus seems to be shedding real tears of blood.

programme.title: Aces 'N Eights
programme.desc: Already taking a gamble settling in the uncharted west, the peaceful settlers of a town destined for railroad greatness suddenly find themselves being ruthlessly gunned down. With no law and order to be found, justice falls onto the shoulders of an elderly rancher (played by Ernest Borgnine) and an accomplished, but retired, gunslinger (played by Casper Van Dien).
Action, with Kim Delaney. A huge earthquake strikes the west coast of America, and things quickly go from bad to worse.

programme.title: Everything She Ever Wanted
programme.desc: Drama with Gina Gershon. A hedonistic woman weds a college dropout much younger than her to access the Atlantan high society as his father is a high-profile lawyer.

programme.title: Murder Without Conviction
programme.desc: One day after school, Morgan is talking to one of her friends, and the subject of horseback riding comes up. Morgan has never done it before and thinks it's easy, so she decides to take some lessons. Simply put, she's horrible. Morgan quits, but the jersey won't let her do that. It transforms her into a gymnist. Domnique Dawes reminds her of how she never gives up after only one try at something. Morgan returns as a new person, and finds a little success the second time around. Meanwhile, Coleman, Nick, and Elliot all need a new pair of shoes, but have absolutely no money. Nick's father, Larry, offers them a job at his office, ""Lighter than Air"". While there, Coleman finds some really cool clothes, Elliot finds office supplies, and Nick builds an enorous sandwich. Obviously, they didn't do their job. However, they meet Jim Harbaugh, star quarterback for the San Diego Chargers (at the time) and Larry lets the three each get a pair of new shoes for no apparent reason.

programme.title: Shattered City: The Halifax Explosion
programme.desc: World War I is brewing and most Canadians are scared of a Germany invasion. So when ships come to visit, everyone is suspicious. What should be a natural transaction, instead become a lead up to disaster.

programme.title: Zoom In
programme.desc: Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

programme.desc: Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. programme.desc: Family drama in which a young woman in 1950s America has her strong religious belief challenged by a series of traumatic events. The woman becomes involved with a local pastor, but her faith is tested when he is sent to serve in Korea.

programme.desc: A photographer in NYC has her refuse photos trashed. Later her boyfriend of 5 years offers his apartment key, not an engagement ring. Fixed by her matchmaker roomie, she meets a single rancher in Wyoming.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Tula Jetters (Ann Margret) is a stubborn widow who still mourns the death of her husband from years ago called "The Captain." She lives alone in a big beautiful home by a lake, but her independence may be threatened by the reality of her diminished vision. She has resisted change, including seeing an eye specialist. Her late husband's niece Billie (Hunter Tylo) and nephew Dave (Sean O'Bryan) have a real estate agency and are now pressuring her to go into assisted living. They have dreams of using her land to make a killing in a big land development. They get a county social worker Jan (Rebecca McFarland) involved in evaluating her independence. Into this mix drops a drifter Henry (Matthew Settle) and his young daughter Cali (Shailene Woodley). Restless Henry becomes a handyman while Cali dreams of having a home here.

programme.title: The Final Days of Planet Earth
programme.desc: When the tragic team of astronauts enlisted to excavate the moon returns to earth, it brings with it an alien-insect race that must harvest human bodies for survival. As their underground colony thrives, so does the fear that mankind's end has arrived.

programme.title: The Final Days of Planet Earth
programme.desc: Lloyd Walker is an anti-heroic archaeologist who, after stumbling upon an alien conspiracy, becomes enmeshed in an against-all-odds battle to save the human race. Part 2/2.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: After Angelica Fanshawe's country noble mother chooses the Catholic faith over the Anglican law of England, her daughter becomes a royal ward of king Charles I, who allows her love marriage to childhood friend and cousin Harry Fanshawe. But social resistance to the king's absolutism, till then maintained by whip in an iron hand, culminates in a parliamentary rebellion, which spills to utter civil war. It means their utter downfall, Harry being executed because his royalist troops capitulated to military genius Oliver Cromwell's while their estate hosts the royal court on permanent flight.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: The people of the besieged city of Oxford are in a desperate situation. Devastated by the King's brutal betrayal, Angelica has been cast out of court, and finds herself destitute and starving. Meanwhile, divisions are beginning to split the Parliamentarians.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
programme.desc: In The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon, Daryl (Noman Reedus) washes ashore in France and struggles to piece together how he got there and why. The series tracks his journey across a broken but resilient France as he hopes to find a way back home. As he makes the journey, though, the connections he forms along the way complicate his ultimate plan.

programme.title: What I Did for Love
programme.desc: Call him a city slicker. Call him a tenderfoot. But don't call him a member of the family yet. Rising L.A. lawyer James White is going home for the holidays with his fiancée, Sadie Ryder, to finally meet her family in rural Pine Gap. After blundering through a bad first impression, James attempts to win over Sadie's lawyer-loathing father Karl by pretending to be a horse-riding, hay-baling, game-hunting, seasoned square dancer. But a pair of worn jeans and a ten-gallon hat don't make a cowboy, and it's going to take more than mere posturing to charm Mr. Ryder...in fact, it just may take a miracle.

programme.title: Pandemic
programme.desc: In the near future, a virus of epic proportions has overtaken the planet. There are more Infected than Uninfected, and humanity is losing its grip on survival. Its only hope is finding a cure. After the fall of New York, Lauren - a doctor - has come to Los Angeles to lead the charge in the hunt for Uninfected survivors, and rescue her family barricaded in their LA home. Lauren's objective is simple: lead her team into the field and rescue survivors, filming their experiences so it can be used for research. But nothing could have prepared them for the mayhem they walk into. As they search for Uninfected, fend off the Infected with whatever weapons they can find, and fight for their lives, we see everything from their point of view - directly from their helmet cameras.

programme.title: Jules Verne's Mysterious Island
programme.desc: The free adaptation of Jules Verne's adventure novel takes us to a mysterious island in the Pacific, which seems to be an ideal refuge for deserters on the run. Union captain Cyrus Smith (Kyle MacLachlan), African-American slave Neb (Omar Gooding), widowed sister Jane (Gabrielle Anwar) and her teenage daughter Helen (Danielle Calvert) and two desperate Confederate soldiers already had their teeth full of civil war in their homeland and issued on an adventurous balloon flight into the unknown. They feel they have just found the Promised Land. However, their dream of freedom did not last long. At first glance, the island is inhabited by monsters that give them nothing, and it seems that their only refuge and rescue may be Captain Nemo (Patrick Stewart) and his submarine. The sooner they understand this, the higher their chances of survival ...

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Kauno „Žalgiris“ - Stambulo „Fenerbahçe“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Olympiacos" - "Real"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals

programme.title: South Africa: Cradle of Killers

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: "Animal Fight Club: Power Struggles" reveals how the even the most epic battles can be won or lost in a split second. In the world of wild animal fights, nothing is ever certain. In this episode we see a female leopard fight a bigger male for her lunch and her life, discover the complex competition amongst the world's largest Great Apes and see how a Nile Monitor Lizard can turn its tail into a show stopping weapon.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals

programme.title: Desert Lions: Surviving At Skeleton Coast
programme.desc: In this true story, lion researcher Dr. Philip Stander follows three orphaned lion cubs from birth to adulthood as they navigate the complexity of survival in one of the world's most unforgiving environments, Namibia's deadly Skeleton Coast. programme.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programme.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu Game Reserve, one of the last sanctuaries for free-roaming leopards, a mother gives birth to two cubs. She'll stop at nothing to protect them. But as climate change tightens its grip, resources dwindle, and a fierce leopard war looms. Over three years of intimate observation, this film unveils rare, breathtaking footage of behaviors never before documented, offering an unprecedented glimpse into the resilience and secrets of this elusive species.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: A central theme of this episode is the remarkable learning behavior of orcas, passed on from generation to generation. As marine biologist and wildlife filmmaker Florian Graner explores the mysteries of orcas, viewers immerse themselves in the different cultures of the orca populations in the Salish Sea. Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor lends the documentary a special depth with her narration and takes viewers on a journey into the world of the largest members of the dolphin family. The documentary sheds light on the fascinating world of the black-and-white giants of the seas, their intelligence, complex social structures, and their impressive ability to pass on knowledge from generation to generation.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 2 sets the scene, now the zebras wander off, a striped echo of part one. If the first episode is dusted in browns and yellows, this is green as the landscape changes and the rain turn again, rising rivers, making it difficult for everyone again, flooding, rushing waters in a raging torrent. Paradise it may be, but it is a harsh paradise. As the rains clear, we catch up with another character introduced in the first episode, our serval mother that had her den flooded; but she reveals that she has survived. And so has her cub - a miracle under these circumstances.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Geniuses
programme.desc: Africa, with its diverse ecosystems from arid deserts to lush forests, is home to some remarkable wild geniuses. While these outliers may not be the strongest, they compensate with their wit. They deploy adaptive strategies and surprising maneuvers to survive against all odds. In the desert, meerkats teach their young to communicate while the caracal uses adaptations to hunt elusive prey, and the wheel spider uses its engineering skills to ride the dunes. In the savannah, the secretarybird cares for her chicks; the dung beetle navigates obstacles; and the Thomson's gazelle relies on keen instinct. In the Highlands, gelada monkeys choose leaders to maintain social order, and the Ethiopian wolf uses clever tricks to feed her cubs. In the forest, the aye-aye and chameleon use their supernatural skills to forage the forest.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: Orcas are the rulers of the seas. These majestic marine mammals have captured the hearts of people with their intelligence and complex family structures. However, since killer whales started attacking boats near Gibraltar, many are asking: Are they threatening us or just playing? The central revelation is that orcas, with specialized "cultures," perfectly exploit the richness of the seas. Surprisingly, there are different orca cultures around the globe. This episode also showcases impressive images of how the curious whales create genuine "fashions," and meet for mating. Their family groups are led by experienced matriarchs who maintain lifelong bonds with their offspring, particularly their sons. Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor lends her voice to the documentary, giving the orcas' stories a special depth.

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: A central theme of this episode is the remarkable learning behavior of orcas, passed on from generation to generation. As marine biologist and wildlife filmmaker Florian Graner explores the mysteries of orcas, viewers immerse themselves in the different cultures of the orca populations in the Salish Sea. Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor lends the documentary a special depth with her narration and takes viewers on a journey into the world of the largest members of the dolphin family. The documentary sheds light on the fascinating world of the black-and-white giants of the seas, their intelligence, complex social structures, and their impressive ability to pass on knowledge from generation to generation.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Madagascar's Weirdest Compilation
programme.desc: Madagascar is an island nation set adrift for millions of years, leaving its wildlife in extreme isolation and causing some bizarre adaptations. Many of the creatures here are found nowhere else on earth. From the feared fossa to the mysterious aye-aye, and a variety of lemurs, in Madagascar, being weird is a way of life.

programme.title: Borneo's Secret Kingdom: Weird And Wild
programme.desc: Flowing from the heart of Borneo, the Kinabatangan River is a cornucopia of life. From deep within mountains, to its ultimate meeting with the sea. Borneo stands at a triple junction of three tectonic plates, and at the crossroads of two oceans. The river is home to 50 mammal species, 200 types of bird, and countless insects. Fuelled by yearly monsoons, at its headwaters, mountains have sustained wet tropical forests. In the floodplains below, strange and more unexpected life inhabits the dense jungle. Beyond lie tangled mangroves nursing the next generation of marine creatures. Finally, at the cusp of the Sulu Sea the journey begins again. In the tropical warmth, moisture evaporates, rises to form clouds, and on mountain ranges rain falls again.

Classic Nat Geo footage is mixed with high-tech graphics, freeze frames and photo finishes to magnify the killer weaponry.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Geniuses
programme.desc: Africa, with its diverse ecosystems from arid deserts to lush forests, is home to some remarkable wild geniuses. While these outliers may not be the strongest, they compensate with their wit. They deploy adaptive strategies and surprising maneuvers to survive against all odds. In the desert, meerkats teach their young to communicate while the caracal uses adaptations to hunt elusive prey, and the wheel spider uses its engineering skills to ride the dunes. In the savannah, the secretarybird cares for her chicks; the dung beetle navigates obstacles; and the Thomson's gazelle relies on keen instinct. In the Highlands, gelada monkeys choose leaders to maintain social order, and the Ethiopian wolf uses clever tricks to feed her cubs. In the forest, the aye-aye and chameleon use their supernatural skills to forage the forest.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 2 sets the scene, now the zebras wander off, a striped echo of part one. If the first episode is dusted in browns and yellows, this is green as the landscape changes and the rain turn again, rising rivers, making it difficult for everyone again, flooding, rushing waters in a raging torrent. Paradise it may be, but it is a harsh paradise. As the rains clear, we catch up with another character introduced in the first episode, our serval mother that had her den flooded; but she reveals that she has survived. And so has her cub - a miracle under these circumstances.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet
programme.desc: Big cats may seem like the ultimate wildlife cliche, but they're locked in a global battle for survival. Powerful and dangerous, they now clash with humans more than ever. This sweeping safari reveals their resilience and adaptability. Cheetahs hunt from cars, jaguars stalk prey underwater and around boats, and India's lions prowl city streets. Familiar species and behaviors take on new drama, with revelations that reaffirm why big cats remain nature's most formidable predators.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programme.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu Game Reserve, one of the last sanctuaries for free-roaming leopards, a mother gives birth to two cubs. She'll stop at nothing to protect them. But as climate change tightens its grip, resources dwindle, and a fierce leopard war looms. Over three years of intimate observation, this film unveils rare, breathtaking footage of behaviors never before documented, offering an unprecedented glimpse into the resilience and secrets of this elusive species.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: Super Reefs
programme.desc: In 2009, National Geographic Pristine Seas explored the southern Line Islands and found pristine coral reefs, thriving ecosystems teeming with sharks and huge schools of fish. But in 2015-16, an unprecedented ocean warming event killed half of the corals. The Pristine Seas team returned in 2021, hoping to see some signs of recovery. What they found instead was the most spectacular recovery of coral reefs ever witnessed.

programme.title: Snakes In the City Compilations
programme.desc: Simon and Sioux are amazed by the respect Indian locals have for their venomous scaled neighbors. The calls are pouring in, and Snake Shyam helps rescue a deadly Russell's viper tangled in netting. Shyam's son, Surya, is breaking concrete steps to help Simon and Sioux finally capture a rat snake. Then, the duo teams with Gowri Shanker to catch and release not one but two enormous king cobras.

programme.title: Death at the River
programme.desc: Embark on a riveting journey along the untamed waters of Africa, where the rivers teem with life, and witness the breathtaking struggle for survival against extreme droughts, cunning predators, and opportunistic hunters of all sizes. Africa's rivers, a paradise for predators, become the arena where prey and predator engage in a relentless dance for life. From the crocodile-infested Mara to the arid landscapes of the Luangwa Valley, each river presents a unique set of perils that only the most resilient can endure. Every moment becomes a high-stakes game where only the most cunning and adaptable will emerge victorious.

programme.title: Snakes In the City Compilations
programme.desc: A dangerous heatwave surges across India, which means more deadly snakes are on the move looking for shelter. Simon and Sioux join Snake Shyam and Gowri Shanker to battle the heat and rescue hiding snakes. The team tries to rescue a spectacled cobra from a water pit and a deadly Russell's viper hiding in a bookstore. For the first time in 30 years, Simon tails and rescues a king cobra by himself!

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: The Critter Fixer docs care for snakes of all sizes with a variety of medical mysteries. A hognose snake battles a dangerous respiratory infection, staff face their fears to treat venomous rescue snakes, and a boa constrictor struggles to get moving. A pint-sized serpent wins over clinic staff, a red-tailed boa presents a mysterious lump, and a Western hognose snake faces an emergency c-section.

programme.title: Croatia's Coast
programme.desc: More than a mere holiday destination, the islands, mountains and forests of the Croatian coast reveal a world of unexpected wildlife and hidden natural treasures. Majestic raptors ride the winds while cicadas sing; geckos defy gravity and the blenny tidal pool-hops. In the mountains, the chamois, lynx and brown bears roam the Velebit range against the backdrop of the breathtaking Adriatic Sea.

programme.title: Africa's River Titans
programme.desc: Africa is a land of giants. Its powerful rivers sculpt the earth and form impressive valleys and waterways home to many imposing and powerful inhabitants. These are the rivers where massive elephants and hippos live, feed and drink and where ancient crocodiles hunt and breed. They share the rivers with other creatures of their kind, such as porcupines, the giant rodents in Africa; the martial eagle, the biggest of its kind on the continent; and the leopard, a giant among the spotted cats.

programme.title: Hunters of the Reef
programme.desc: Tropical coral reefs are the picture of colorful, light-dappled tranquility - but that's a scuba diver's perspective. To the scaly and gilled inhabitants, it's a fish-eat-fish environment ruled by pods of dolphins who prowl the area at mealtimes while everyone else runs for cover. Incredible weapons, camouflage, venomous defenses and exceptional strategies have evolved among the smaller hunters in constant competition. Lionfish hunt in packs, injecting any objectors with venom from their frilly spikes. The mantis shrimp has polarized vision and the fastest jab on the planet. Cuttlefish morph their skin to match the sand, then attack with tentacle harpoons. The hunt is on in the shifting tides!

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a rich and diverse land. Stunning landscapes harbor elusive critters that have evolved to thrive here. But survival is not assured because the abundant prey is closely followed by powerful predators. From giant killer dolphins to the largest cat in the Americas, this vast continent is a lethal predator battleground.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: Nature's vicious battles for survival come at every scale, from 6 ton Elephants, fighting in a testosterone fuelled blind fury, to slime covered inch and half long amphibian kick boxers, dangling in the jaws of death. This is a no-holds barred look at cold-hearted killers in the wild, revealing ambush experts with piercing canines, slithering assassins with crushing coils, and multi-layered fangs dealing death, in Animal Fight Club.

programme.title: Dragons Uncovered
programme.desc: The Komodo Dragon has captured our imaginations for over a century, yet so much about this incredible lizard remains a mystery. A creature with survival skills and physical characteristics seen in apex predators across the animal kingdom, and the ability to take down predators ten times its size. The secrets of the Komodo Dragon are revealed.

This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a land of extremes. Many hundred thousand square miles of forests, grasslands and mountains. Survival is a daunting proposition. But when the going gets tough, the wild inhabitants morph into oddballs. Millennia of weird evolution have made this giant continent a land of mutants. Expect the unexpected because here, outlandish is the new normal.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a land of extremes. Many hundred thousand square miles of forests, grasslands and mountains. Existing here is a daunting proposition, and some well-known animals have adapted by growing large or very small, each strategy maximizing their chance of survival.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a rich and diverse land. Stunning landscapes harbor elusive critters that have evolved to thrive here. But survival is not assured because the abundant prey is closely followed by powerful predators. From giant killer dolphins to the largest cat in the Americas, this vast continent is a lethal predator battleground.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines
programme.desc: We start on the tiny island of Batan, meeting a unique viper and a ubiquitous but also giant, land crab. Luzon is the main island of the Philippines. We drop in to Mindoro to see the most endangered large mammal in the Philippines, the tamaraw.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines
programme.desc: Moving from turtles of the Palawan coast to the unique National Marine Park at Tubbataha, to meet giants, whale sharks and manta rays. We also see how people can mediate between people and wildlife as we join a snake hunting team catching and translocating a deadly Samar cobra.

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: Each year, the waters of the Okavango River arrive at the Kalahari in the dead of winter — the driest time of year — transforming the sand into Eden. Discover how this extraordinary event sustains one of Earth's greatest wildlife spectacles. As water spreads across the delta, elephant families march across the desert, lions stake their claims, hidden ecosystems awaken, and crocodiles, fish, birds and insects respond in perfect synchrony to the river's advance. But this miracle is fleeting, and survival demands perfect timing. From underwater worlds concealed beneath papyrus roots to lion ambushes on flooded plains, follow the rhythm of a river that awakens, feeds and withdraws, leaving both abundance and loss in its wake. This is the story of a place where everything depends on water … and where Eden never lasts.

programme.title: Death at the River
programme.desc: Embark on a riveting journey along the untamed waters of Africa, where the rivers teem with life, and witness the breathtaking struggle for survival against extreme droughts, cunning predators, and opportunistic hunters of all sizes. Africa's rivers, a paradise for predators, become the arena where prey and predator engage in a relentless dance for life. From the crocodile-infested Mara to the arid landscapes of the Luangwa Valley, each river presents a unique set of perils that only the most resilient can endure. Every moment becomes a high-stakes game where only the most cunning and adaptable will emerge victorious.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 1 of our series starts with the dust of the disappearing migration as it heads off across the river and leaves. Behind them, hundreds if not thousands of other animals cannot move, or won't move, because they are locked into territories, invisible barriers that say to them, 'leave your bubble at your peril'. This is their story. It is the story about what happens between September and the following July. Nine months of wildebeest-free Mara.

programme.title: Wallykazam!
programme.desc: Wallykazam! follows the adventures of a troll named Wally and his pet dragon, Norville, who live in a forest with giants, goblins, ogres, sprites and other mythical creatures. Wally uses his magic stick to make words come to life on screen that start with a specific letter, sound or rhyme. Each episode features a new set of magic words that Wally uses to playfully transform the world around him.

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Meet Bloom, a girl from Earth, who after she finds out that she is a fairy joins Alfea College on the planet Magix- a magical universe that is inhabited by fairies, witches and other mythical creatures. At Alfea College, fairy warriors from all over the universe study to improve their supernatural powers and here Bloom befriends five other fairies - Stella, the fairy of the Sun, Flora, the fairy of nature, Tecna, the fairy of technology, Musa, the fairy of music and Aisha, the fairy of waves. Together, this group of girls known as the Winx, become best friends and the force to be reckoned with as they experience incredible adventures while defending their universe from varous enemies.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

They each bring something different to the friendship - Rock is the moral compass, Paper is the practical one, and Scissors is the right amount of chaos. Together, they get into the wildest adventures.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. Now living in his permanent home at the Jade Palace with the rest of the Furious Five, Po will have to take on new responsibilities and face brand-new adversaries (not seen in the movies) in his continuing education as the Dragon Warrior...for being the Dragon Warrior is not a destination, it's a journey (unfortunately for Po, that journey is uphill).

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: As one of Aang's little detours, the group heads toward the island of Kyoshi. But soon they learn that the townspeople don't trust foreigners at all; however, when Aang proves to them that he is the Avatar they are treated as guests of honor. Katara wants to get some supplies and leave as soon as possible, while Aang is enjoying his time as a celebrity. Little do they know, though, that the Fire Nation has tracked them down. Also, Sokka meets and trains with a female warrior named Suki. Will Aang be able to save the village from the wrath of the Fire Nation?

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Gullible Pants: SpongeBob is left in charge of the Krusty Krab while Mr. Krabs steps out for 15 minutes, and he is determined to make it the best-managed 15 minutes ever! So when Squidward tells him that there are a lot of rules that he doesn't know about-like never interrupting Squidward's naps-SpongeBob is eager to learn and follow everything he says. Overbooked: SpongeBob's got a full day, and he's determined to do everything he's scheduled to do: help fix Mr. Krabs' telescope, go to Patrick's birthday party, and help with Sandy's science presentation. Too bad everything's scheduled for the same exact time!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: No Hat for Pat: Patrick is sick of all of his friends not being able to play with him because they have to put on their Krusty Krab hats and go to work. So when Mr. Krabs offers him a job as a sign-holder, Patrick is thrilled because it means he gets to wear a hat and work with all his friends! But Pat soon learns that wearing a hat isn't as simple as it looks. Toy Store of Doom: A new toy store has opened up in Bikini Bottom, and SpongeBob and Patrick couldn't be happier! In fact, they are having so much fun at the toy store that they accidentally get locked in when it closes. They soon find out that things are a lot different at the toy store when no one's around...

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raphael's brothers just don't understand him. Not only does he NEED to fight, he's really good at it, or at least that's what his new boxing trainer named Spuds told him. Spuds even ENCOURAGES Raph to work out his anger and negativity through fighting, even if his family and the annoying Pigeon Pete don't get it. But although the Turtles don't see eye to eye, they must work together to stop a rampaging Rocksteady and Bebop from wrecking the city! Social media blew up with videos of the two Mutanimals going berserk, fighting each other without seeming to know what was going on around them. And all the while, doing some serious damage to the city! As the dust settles, is there someone behind the whole plot, pulling the strings?

programme.title: Transformers: Earthspark
programme.desc: A famous truck blog wants to feature Optimus Prime! Robby, Hashtag, and Jawbreaker decide to help the Autobot leader prepare for the interview and photoshoot, but determine his trailer needs cleaning. They assure him they'll be back in time for the photoshoot later. Jawbreaker stays behind to coach Optimus for the interview portion while Robby and Hashtag take the trailer to be washed. The duo takes their eyes off the trailer for mere seconds and the trailer disappears! Off in the distance, they spot Aftermath with the trailer in tow. Robby and Hashtag pursue the trailer as it changes hands from Decepticon to Decepticon, suffering more and more damage as the day goes on. Robby fears Optimus' reaction when he finally recovers the heavily-damaged trailer, but his siblings come to his rescue, repairing the trailer and delivering it right on time.

programme.desc: Draculaura, Clawdeen & Frankie meet Twyla, a boogey monster, while having a sleepover in the library. // Frankie, fascinated by Kuma's scaritage, does a ritual unsupervised causing trouble for all Monster High's undead students!

programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Feline Fervor: King Julien is literally bounced out of his kingdom and onto the New York streets. A kindly old lady thinks he's a cat and swoops him up. Sitting behind a desk doing paperwork instead! Hans takes advantage of the situation and targets a massive weapons lab, and without Skipper the penguins are easily captured. How can Skipper combat the evil puffin if he's in a puffy state?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Mental Hen: Kowalski has a rival, if you even can call it a rivalry. A Delaware Blue Hen has taken up residence at the zoo, and she has the amazing ability to predict the future! Kowalski doesn't buy the psychic chicken hype and sets out to discredit her. The truth turns out to be far more sinister than a simple sports-pickin' chicken, and Kowalski will have to use all his best moves to wiggle out of this mess. Thumb Drive: The penguins need a thumb, and Maurice's fits the bill nicely. Using the opposable digit thumbprint to break into a secret weapons lab gets the penguins all atwitter. King Julien is unhappy that his right hand man is running around on missions with the birds so he sets out to sabotage the mission. As with most of King Julien's plans, this scheme turns out to be "thumbs down"!

programme.title: Jurassic World - La rinascita
programme.desc: Scarlett Johansson e Mahershala Ali nel settimo kolossal della saga, diretto da Gareth Edwards. Su un'isola abitata da voraci mostri preistorici, una squadra speciale deve estrarre dal sangue delle creature un campione di DNA con cui sviluppare un farmaco rivoluzionario.

programme.title: Il mostro
programme.desc: Residente in un condominio alla periferia di Roma, l'innocuo e gentile Loris è scambiato per un maniaco che ha già seviziato e ucciso 19 donne. Per smascherarlo, la polizia gli mette in casa un'avvenente poliziotta.

programme.title: Ben - Rabbia animale
programme.desc: Lucy torna dall'università e incontra la sua famiglia e lo scimpanzé Ben. Durante una festa, Ben viene infettato dalla rabbia e diventa aggressivo. Lucy e i suoi amici si rifugiano in piscina.

programme.title: E poi si vede
programme.desc: Tre ragazzi competono per un posto di lavoro nell'ufficio legale del municipio. Federico conta sull'aiuto di suo padre, consigliere comunale, Fabrizio cerca un'altra opportunità e Luca, ragazzo privilegiato, si unisce alla corsa.

programme.title: Blink Twice
programme.desc: L'opera prima di Zoe Kravitz è un thriller angosciante con Naomi Ackie, Channing Tatum e Christian Slater. In vacanza sull'isola privata di un miliardario con una comitiva di vip, una ragazza scopre la scioccante verità dietro la strana amnesia che colpisce solo le donne del gruppo.

programme.title: Largo Winch - Il prezzo del denaro
programme.desc: Tomer Sisley contro James Franco nell'action che rilancia il personaggio creato da Jean Van Hamme. Il magnate Largo Winch, al centro di un complotto, deve regolare i conti con il passato e intraprendere una pericolosa avventura in vari paesi del mondo per ritrovare il figlio rapito.

programme.title: Paycheck
programme.desc: John Woo dirige Ben Affleck, dal racconto di Philip K. Dick. Un ingegnere, costretto a cancellare i ricordi al termine di ogni progetto top secret, scopre di essere vittima di un complotto.

programme.title: Una Di Famiglia - The Housemaid
programme.desc: Dopo essere caduta in disgrazia, Millie trova con sollievo un impiego come domestica presso Nina e Andrew, una coppia benestante. Ma presto si rende conto che gli oscuri segreti della famiglia sono molto più pericolosi dei suoi.

programme.title: Immaturi - Il viaggio
programme.desc: Commedia con Raoul Bova, Ambra Angiolini e Barbora Bobulova. Per celebrare la raggiunta maturita', gli amici scelgono una vacanza su un'isola greca, circondati da mille tentazioni.

programme.title: Flight Risk - Trappola ad alta quota
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg, Michelle Dockey e Topher Grace in un action di Mel Gibson. Un agente federale sta scortando a bordo di un piccolo aereo un testimone chiave nel processo contro un clan mafioso, ma il pilota del velivolo si rivela un sicario incaricato di uccidere il pentito.

programme.title: Gli Occhi Degli Altri
programme.desc: Sull'isola di proprietà di un ricco marchese, l'arrivo di Elena segna l'inizio di una storia d'amore appassionata. Ben presto i giochi erotici si trasformano in ossessione.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Un appassionante thriller con il Premio Oscar Morgan Freeman e John Cusack ("2012"). Frank Cordell era un sicario al servizio del governo che ha deciso di 'mettersi in proprio'. Arrestato in una piccola citta', riesce a fuggire mentre viene scortato fino a Washington da alcuni agenti dell'FBI. Frank riesce a nascondersi tra i boschi, dove si trova anche Ray Keene, un ex poliziotto in campeggio con il figlio Chris. Dopo averlo tratto in salvo, Ray vuole consegnarlo alla giustizia ma gli uomini di Cordell sono sulle loro tracce per liberarlo e portare a termine il loro incarico.

programme.desc: Un disertore della CIA accusa l'ufficiale Evelyn Salt di essere una spia russa. Convinta di essere vittima di un complotto, la donna si dà alla fuga.

programme.desc: Antonio Albanese e Paola Cortellesi nel sequel di Riccardo Milani. Tre anni dopo la fine della loro storia, Monica si rivolge a Giovanni per tirarsi fuori dai guai.

programme.desc: Liam Neeson, Monica Bellucci e Guy Pearce in un action di Martin Campbell. Un sicario, malato di Alzheimer, sceglie di non portare a termine un incarico quando scopre che l’obiettivo è una ragazzina. Si allea così con un poliziotto contro una spietata organizzazione criminale.

programme.title: Il giorno piu' bello
programme.desc: Paolo Kessisoglu, Luca Bizzarri e Violante Placido in una commedia di Andrea Zalone. Un wedding planner indebitato deve organizzare un matrimonio impeccabile, ma nulla andra' come previsto.

programme.title: Gangster Squad
programme.desc: Josh Brolin, Ryan Gosling e Sean Penn in un poliziesco tratto da una storia vera. Los Angeles, anni 40: una squadra di agenti incorruttibili lotta per colpire al cuore l'impero di un gangster.

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al thriller diretto e interpretato da Ben Affleck. Iran, 1979: uno specialista della Cia attua un geniale piano per liberare un gruppo di ostaggi.

programme.title: No Other Choice - Non c'è altra scelta
programme.desc: Le contraddizioni della società coreana nel film di Park Chan-wook presentato a Venezia. Licenziato dopo 25 anni, un uomo vede andare in frantumi la sua vita "perfetta".

programme.title: Codice d'onore
programme.desc: Tom Cruise sfida Jack Nicholson in un dramma giudiziario con Demi Moore e Kevin Bacon. Tre avvocati militari difendono due marines accusati dell'omicidio di un commilitone.

programme.title: La Riunione Di Condominio
programme.desc: In un edificio nel centro di Madrid, una normale assemblea tra vicini per decidere della sostituzione dell'ascensore si trasforma in una guerra. Tutto perché si viene a sapere che un nuovo inquilino con problemi di mentali affitterà un appartamento.

programme.title: Bolero
programme.desc: La genesi ossessiva della celebre partitura di Maurice Ravel nel biopic di Anne Fontaine. La vita, la carriera e il tormento creativo dell'artista, fino al suo capolavoro musicale.

programme.title: Sotto attacco
programme.desc: Stephen Dorff sale sul ring in un action-drama dallo sceneggiatore di "American History X". Diventato campione di MMA come reazione a un padre violento, Cash si ritrova a gestire un figlio che vuole seguire le sue orme e la nascita di un bambino affetto da una rara sindrome.

programme.title: Ennio Doris: C'e' anche domani
programme.desc: La storia del banchiere gentile Ennio Doris, fondatore di Banca Mediolanum. Da ragazzo che aveva un sogno a uomo d'oro della finanza italiana.

programme.title: The Company Men
programme.desc: Dramma sociale con Ben Affleck, Kevin Costner e Tommy Lee Jones. La vita di un agiato impiegato americano subisce un netto ridimensionamento quando perde il lavoro a causa della Recessione.

programme.title: The Life of Chuck
programme.desc: Dalla penna di Stephen King, un emozionante inno alla vita diretto da Mike Flanagan. La straordinaria vita dell'uomo comune Charles Krantz (Tom Hiddleston) raccontata a ritroso.

programme.title: Saint Judy
programme.desc: Michelle Monaghan nella vera storia di Judy Wood, l'avvocato che ha cambiato la legge sul diritto d'asilo negli Usa. Assunta in uno studio di Los Angeles, si batte per una donna afgana.

programme.title: Nata per te
programme.desc: Sky Original ispirato a una storia vera e piena d'amore diretta da Fabio Mollo. Luca, single e omosessuale con un forte desiderio di paternita', lotta per ottenere l’affidamento di Alba.

programme.title: La verità secondo Maureen K.
programme.desc: Pellicola biografica con Isabelle Huppert protagonista. Maureen Kernay, sindacalista in un'azienda leader nel campo nucleare, scopre un segreto che potrebbe sconvolgere l'intera nazione.

programme.title: Starman
programme.desc: Il docufilm di Gianluca Cerasola dedicato a Luca Parmitano, il primo astronauta italiano a diventare comandante della ISS e a battere il record di permanenza extraveicolare nello Spazio.

programme.title: C'era una volta a New York
programme.desc: Nella New York degli anni Venti, le sorelle polacche Ewa e Magda emigrano dalla Polonia a New York. Giunte a Ellis Island, scoprono che Magda è malata di tubercolosi e viene messa in quarantena. Ewa si ritrova sola e indifesa.

programme.title: Ammazzare stanca
programme.desc: La storia vera di Antonio Zagari, figlio di un boss della 'ndrangheta calabrese trapiantata in Lombardia. Nei primi anni '70 Antonio sviluppa un'avversione fisica per la violenza e decide di ribellarsi alla tradizione criminale di famiglia.

programme.title: Ennio Doris: C'e' anche domani
programme.desc: La storia del banchiere gentile Ennio Doris, fondatore di Banca Mediolanum. Da ragazzo che aveva un sogno a uomo d'oro della finanza italiana.

programme.title: Il socio
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di John Grisham, thriller di Sydney Pollack con Gene Hackman e Tom Cruise. Assunto da un prestigioso studio legale, un avvocato inesperto viene coinvolto in loschi intrighi.

programme.title: Prova a prendermi
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Tom Hanks in un biopic diretto da Steven Spielberg. La vera storia di Frank Abagnale, geniale truffatore sulle cui tracce si mette un caparbio agente dell'FBI.

programme.title: La verità secondo Maureen K.
programme.desc: Pellicola biografica con Isabelle Huppert protagonista. Maureen Kernay, sindacalista in un'azienda leader nel campo nucleare, scopre un segreto che potrebbe sconvolgere l'intera nazione.

programme.title: House of the Dragon
programme.desc: Mentre Rhaenyra e Daemon si concentrano sul modo migliore per affrontare Ormund, le tensioni tra i loro alleati, messi da parte, cominciano a esplodere.

programme.title: Red Rocket
programme.desc: Trovandosi in difficoltà a Los Angeles, l'ex pornostar Mikey Saber decide di tornare nella città natale di Texas City, dove nessuno sembra particolarmente entusiasta di rivederlo.

programme.title: Boogie Nights - L'altra Hollywood
programme.desc: Paul Thomas Anderson firma l'epopea di un promettente pornoattore, interpretato da Mark Wahlberg, sullo sfondo dei trasgressivi anni 70. Nel cast Heather Graham e Julianne Moore.

programme.title: La Voce Di Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Il 29 gennaio 2024 gli operatori della Mezzaluna rossa ricevono la telefonata di Liyan Hamada, una quindicenne di Gaza intrappolata in macchina assieme a Hind Rajab, sua cugina di cinque anni, a seguito dell'attacco di un carro armato israeliano.

programme.title: The Young Messiah
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Anne Rice, una pellicola che ripercorre l'infanzia di Gesu'. A 7 anni il futuro Messia lascia l'Egitto per tornare a Nazareth dove scopre le sue vere origini.

programme.title: Radioactive
programme.desc: Rosamund Pike, Sam Riley e Anya Taylor-Joy nella biografia di Marie Curie. La vita della scienziata polacca, naturalizzata francese, che ha cambiato il mondo con le sue scoperte, salendo in cattedra in una società dominata dagli uomini e aggiudicandosi per due volte il Nobel.

programme.title: Amata
programme.desc: Due donne affrontano lotte opposte per la fertilità: la giovane Nunzia è alle prese con una gravidanza indesiderata e desidera giorni spensierati, mentre Maddalena, a 40 anni, cerca disperatamente di concepire un figlio.

programme.title: Diamanti
programme.desc: Ferzan Ozpetek firma il suo maggior successo con un maestoso cast al femminile. Un regista convoca le sue attrici preferite: vuole fare un film sulle donne ma non svela altro.

programme.title: La verità secondo Maureen K.
programme.desc: Pellicola biografica con Isabelle Huppert protagonista. Maureen Kernay, sindacalista in un'azienda leader nel campo nucleare, scopre un segreto che potrebbe sconvolgere l'intera nazione.

programme.title: Interstellar
programme.desc: Oscar agli effetti speciali per il kolossal sci-fi di Christopher Nolan con un cast stellare. Un gruppo di astronauti sfrutta un varco spazio-temporale per trovare nuovi pianeti.

programme.title: Il postino
programme.desc: Il commovente addio al cinema di Massimo Troisi in un film emozionante con Philippe Noiret e Maria Grazia Cucinotta. Il compianto attore partenopeo interpreta Mario, un umile postino che instaura un intenso rapporto d'amicizia con il poeta cileno Pablo Neruda, in esilio su un'isola nel Golfo di Napoli. Nei frequenti colloqui con l'artista Mario impara la magia della poesia, mentre una bellissima ragazza del luogo entra nella sua vita. Nel frattempo, la conclusione del confino separera' i due amici lasciando al destino la possibilita' di rivedersi di nuovo. Oscar alle musiche di Luis Bacalov.

programme.title: Ispettore Callaghan: Il Caso Skorpio È Tuo!
programme.desc: Uno spietato serial killer e' l'obiettivo dell'ispettore Callaghan, che ricorre ai modi poco ortodossi della giustizia privata pur di arrestare il criminale.

programme.title: Romanzo criminale
programme.desc: Michele Placido dirige Favino, Rossi Stuart, Accorsi, Scamarcio, Santamaria, Fresi e Germano per raccontare ascesa e caduta della Banda della Magliana nell'Italia degli anni 70.

programme.title: La ricerca della felicità
programme.desc: Esordio hollywoodiano per Gabriele Muccino che dirige Will Smith in un film emozionante. San Francisco, anni 80: un uomo disperato trova la forza di ricominciare grazie a suo figlio.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: Aprile
programme.desc: Nanni Moretti dirige e interpreta una commedia pungente che e' insieme opera autobiografica e resoconto critico delle vicende politiche, dalla primavera del 1994 all’estate del 1997.

programme.title: Ispettore Callaghan: Il Caso Skorpio È Tuo!
programme.desc: Uno spietato serial killer e' l'obiettivo dell'ispettore Callaghan, che ricorre ai modi poco ortodossi della giustizia privata pur di arrestare il criminale.

programme.title: Le Mans '66 - La grande sfida
programme.desc: Due Oscar per il biopic di James Mangold con Christian Bale e Matt Damon, sulla storica sfida tra Ford e Ferrari. Carroll Shelby ha vinto la prestigiosa 24 Ore di Le Mans nel 1959 ma una patologia cardiaca gli proibisce di continuare a gareggiare. Si reinventa allora designer di automobili e accetta la proposta della Ford: progettare una macchina in grado di battere il bolide della Ferrari. Ma oltre al motore, per vincere serve anche un pilota super. E la scelta di Shelby ricade su Ken Miles, un intrepido e irascibile pilota britannico. Nel cast Remo Girone interpreta Enzo Ferrari.

programme.title: Le Déluge: Gli ultimi giorni di Maria Antonietta
programme.desc: Gianluca Jodice dirige una pellicola, premiata con 4 David e 2 Nastri d'Argento, che indaga le psicologie di Luigi XVI (Guillaume Canet) e Maria Antonietta (Melanie Laurent).

programme.title: Ave, Cesare!
programme.desc: Siamo nei primi anni 50, Eddie Mannix è impegnato a risolvere tutti i problemi degli attori e registi della Capitol Pictures. I suoi ultimi incarichi comprendono un regista scontento, un cowboy cantante, un bel nuotatore e un affascinante ballerino.

programme.title: Anna Karenina
programme.desc: Keira Knightley e Jude Law nell'adattamento del capolavoro di Lev Tolstoj. 1874: la moglie di un funzionario della Russia zarista si innamora di un giovane ufficiale. Oscar ai costumi.

programme.title: Non ci resta che piangere
programme.desc: Un maestro elementare e un bidello si ritrovano, per uno strano scherzo del caso, nel 1492. Decidono di recarsi a Palos, in Andalusia, per fermare Cristoforo Colombo e impedirgli di scoprire le Americhe.

programme.title: Lamborghini: The Man Behind the Legend
programme.desc: Lamborghini, dagli inizi modesti come costruttore di trattori alla famigerata rivalità con Enzo Ferrari, ma anche la storia dell'Italia degli anni '50, un Paese impegnato nella complessa transizione verso una nuova modernità industrializzata.

programme.title: Into the Wild - Nelle terre selvagge
programme.desc: Le musiche di Eddie Vedder e la regia di Sean Penn per un film che celebra la ricerca della liberta'. Un diciottenne lascia agi e vincoli familiari per un intimo viaggio a contatto con la natura.

programme.title: Ops! È già Natale
programme.desc: Una coppia porta la giovane figlia, Claire, nell'albergo del nonno in Italia per dirle che si stanno separando. Nella speranza di riavvicinarli, Claire chiede a tutta la famiglia di trascorrere un ultimo Natale insieme, anche se è agosto.

programme.title: Una notte al museo
programme.desc: Successo planetario per Ben Stiller, Robin Williams e tante altre star nel primo capitolo della celebre saga. Larry Daley e' disoccupato e ha divorziato da poco. Se non trova un lavoro in fretta, rischia di perdere la custodia congiunta del figlio, cosi' accetta di fare il guardiano notturno al Museo di Storia Naturale di New York. Un lavoro tranquillo, pensa Larry, ma gli basta il primo giro di ricognizione per scoprire che al calar del sole le statue dei personaggi famosi e gli animali impagliati prendono vita, creando un discreto caos e dando vita a una serie di incredibili avventure.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Blockbuster di Halloween per tutta la famiglia. Il Conte Dracula organizza una festa per il compleanno della figlia Mavis, ma tra gli ospiti c'e' un intruso...

programme.title: Giu' per il tubo
programme.desc: Avventure e sfrenata comicita' in un'animazione targata DreamWorks. Londra: per liberarsi di un roditore dei bassifondi, un raffinato topo 'da salotto' finisce nelle fogne di Ratropolis.

programme.title: Il giorno piu' bello del mondo
programme.desc: Commedia di grande successo per tutta la famiglia diretta e interpretata da Alessandro Siani. Un impresario teatrale deve difendere un bambino speciale da un team di scienziati.

programme.title: La piccola Amelie
programme.desc: Amélie è una bambina belga nata in Giappone. Grazie al suo amico, Nishio San, il mondo è pieno di avventure e scoperte. Il giorno del suo terzo compleanno, un evento cambia il corso della sua vita.

programme.title: Z La formica
programme.desc: Spettacolari avventure in un gioiello d'animazione della Dreamworks. Per fare colpo sulla Principessa Bala, Z si finge formica-soldato e si trova coinvolto nella guerra contro le termiti.

programme.title: Megamind
programme.desc: Allegra parodia del mondo dei supereroi in un gioiello d'animazione DreamWorks. Annoiato dalla mancanza di un rivale, Megamind ne crea uno grazie al dna del nemico sconfitto, Metroman.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Mason Thames e Gerard Butler nell'emozionante live action che riporta in scena la storia dell’amata trilogia di animazione. Sull'isola di Berk, dove vichinghi e draghi sono acerrimi nemici da generazioni, il giovane Hiccup sfida la tradizione facendo amicizia con il temibile drago Furia Buia.

programme.title: King - Un cucciolo da salvare
programme.desc: Avventurosa pellicola animalista. Due ragazzini francesi, Ines e Alex, aiutano un cucciolo di leone destinato alla tratta dei bracconieri a ritornare nel suo habitat in Africa.

programme.title: Sinbad - La leggenda dei sette mari
programme.desc: Il magico mondo del leggendario pirata in un gioiello d'animazione targato Dreamworks. Sinbad viene ingiustamente accusato del furto dell'inestimabile 'Libro della Pace'. Gli viene data la possibilità di ritrovarlo, anche per salvare la vita dell'amico Proteo ma il focoso marinaio non ne ha tanta voglia: meglio andare alle Isole Fiji, in cerca di sole e divertimento_ Ma a vigilare sulla missione c'è la coraggiosa Marina... Nella versione originale le voci di Sinbad e Marina sono di Brad Pitt e Catherine Zeta-Jones, doppiate in italiano da Pino Insegno e Claudia Gerini.

programme.title: Bambi - Una vita nei boschi
programme.desc: Un piccolo cerbiatto di nome Bambi è appena venuto al mondo. Con l'aiuto dei suoi amici, Bambi vivrà ogni tipo di avventura che lo preparerà ad assumere il suo ruolo di principe della foresta.

programme.title: Belle & Sebastien - Amici per sempre
programme.desc: Terzo avventuroso capitolo tratto dal romanzo di Cecile Aubry. Un uomo sostiene di essere il proprietario di Belle; ma Sebastien farà di tutto per non separarsi dalla fedele amica.

programme.title: Belle e Sebastien - Next Generation
programme.desc: Un omaggio ai personaggi creati da Cecile Aubry ambientato ai giorni nostri. Il giovane Sebastien, in vacanza in montagna dalla nonna, stringe amicizia con un bellissimo cane Patou.

programme.title: Intervista A Edoardo Leo - Ep. 476 - Intervista A Edoardo Leo
programme.desc: Intervista A Edoardo Leo - In occasione dell'uscita in sala del nuovo film di Massimiliano Bruno, Francesco Castelnuovo intervista il protagonista maschile, Edoardo Leo, che ci racconta aneddoti dal set.

programme.title: 100% Lupo
programme.desc: Avventura d'animazione tratta da un libro per ragazzi. Freddy Lupin, discendente di una stirpe di fieri lupi mannari, si trasforma misteriosamente in un tenero barboncino.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Shrek", un altro emozionante capolavoro d'animazione. Hiccup, figlio di un capo vichingo, affronta il drago che minaccia la sua tribu' ma finisce per stringerci amicizia.

programme.desc: Gabby parte con la nonna in direzione Cat Francisco. Ma quando la sua casa delle bambole finisce nelle mani di un'eccentrica gattara di nome Vera, la bambina si lancia in un'avventura nel mondo reale.

programme.title: E.T. L'extra-terrestre
programme.desc: 4 Oscar all'emozionante capolavoro di fantascienza di Steven Spielberg. Un bambino protegge dagli scienziati un alieno rimasto sulla Terra e lo aiuta a tornare sul suo pianeta.

programme.title: Sonic - Il film
programme.desc: Jim Carrey e James Marsden, fra live action e animazione, nell’avventura basata sulla serie di videogiochi della Sega. Sonic, un porcospino più veloce del suono, approda sulla Terra per sfuggire ai cacciatori che lo braccano e si ritrova ad affrontare un diabolico scienziato.

programme.title: Sinbad - La leggenda dei sette mari
programme.desc: Il magico mondo del leggendario pirata in un gioiello d'animazione targato Dreamworks. Sinbad viene ingiustamente accusato del furto dell'inestimabile 'Libro della Pace'. Gli viene data la possibilità di ritrovarlo, anche per salvare la vita dell'amico Proteo ma il focoso marinaio non ne ha tanta voglia: meglio andare alle Isole Fiji, in cerca di sole e divertimento_ Ma a vigilare sulla missione c'è la coraggiosa Marina... programme.title: I Goonies
programme.desc: Richard Donner firma una memorabile avventura ideata e prodotta da Steven Spielberg. Un gruppo di ragazzi trova una mappa che conduce al leggendario tesoro di un pirata.

programme.title: Inkheart - La leggenda di Cuore d'inchiostro
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser ed Helen Mirren in un'entusiasmante avventura fantasy. Una ragazzina di 12 anni e suo padre hanno la straordinaria capacità di rendere umani i personaggi dei romanzi. Un potere magico che ha un solo effetto collaterale, tutt'altro che secondario: per ogni personaggio che prende vita, una persona reale sparisce in un libro. Proprio come accaduto 10 anni prima a Resa, moglie di Mortimer Folchart detto Mo e madre della piccola Maggie. Che ora, dopo aver trovato "Inkheart", libro fantasy sul Medioevo, forse potrà tornare finalmente a casa. Tratto da un romanzo di Cornelia Funke.

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: Il marchio DreamWorks su un film d'animazione tratto dai libri a fumetti per bambini di Dav Pilkey. Feriti in un incidente, un cane poliziotto e il suo collega umano sono sottoposti a un intervento che li fonde insieme. Nasce Dog Man, creatura ibrida al servizio della città contro un malvagio gatto arancione.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Shrek", un altro emozionante capolavoro d'animazione. Hiccup, figlio di un capo vichingo, affronta il drago che minaccia la sua tribu' ma finisce per stringerci amicizia.

programme.title: C'era una volta il Principe Azzurro
programme.desc: Dal produttore di "Shrek", un film d’animazione sull'avvenente eroe delle fiabe. Il principe Filippo vuole spezzare l'incantesimo che lo ha 'condannato' a sedurre tutte le donne.

programme.title: Sonic - Il film
programme.desc: Jim Carrey e James Marsden, fra live action e animazione, nell’avventura basata sulla serie di videogiochi della Sega. Sonic, un porcospino più veloce del suono, approda sulla Terra per sfuggire ai cacciatori che lo braccano e si ritrova ad affrontare un diabolico scienziato.

programme.title: Vicky e il suo cucciolo
programme.desc: Toccante storia di amicizia sui monti del Cantal. Dopo la morte della madre, la piccola Victoria si e' chiusa nel mutismo. Un cucciolo di lupo le restituira' la voce e il sorriso.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer 2
programme.desc: Sequel del capolavoro d'animazione Dreamworks. Il giovane vichingo Hiccup e il suo fedele amico Sdentato difendono il loro villaggio da un temibile drago rinnegato.

programme.title: C'è tempo
programme.desc: Stefano Fresi in una commedia 'on the road' di Walter Veltroni. Alla morte del padre, un quarantenne 'osservatore di arcobaleni' scopre di avere un fratellastro minorenne.

programme.title: Rosanero
programme.desc: Andrea Porporati dirige Salvatore Esposito in una commedia per tutta la famiglia targata Sky Original. Al risveglio dal coma, una bambina si ritrova nel corpo di un boss e viceversa.

programme.title: Troppo cattivi 2
programme.desc: Pirotecnico sequel dell'amata saga di DreamWorks Animation con i personaggi nati sulle graphic novel di Aaron Blabey. I 'Troppo Cattivi' faticano a integrarsi in società a causa della loro reputazione e vengono coinvolti in una rapina ad alto rischio orchestrata da una nuova squadra di criminali: le Troppo Cattive.

programme.title: Tom & Jerry
programme.desc: Le origini di una storica rivalità in una pellicola che mescola animazione classica e live action. Il topo Jerry si trasferisce in un hotel di New York per assistere alle nozze del secolo, costringendo l'organizzatore dell'evento ad assumere il gatto Tom per liberarsene.

programme.title: Moon il panda
programme.desc: Gilles de Maistre firma un inno alla bellezza della natura e all'amicizia tra uomo e animale. Cina: lo svogliato dodicenne Tian, sempre distratto dai videogame, viene mandato dalla nonna sulle montagne del Sichuan dove stringe un legame profondo con un cucciolo di panda.

programme.title: Il cacciatore di giganti
programme.desc: Il regista di "X-Men" spalanca la porta di un mondo fantasy. Grazie a dei fagioli magici, il giovane contadino Jack si ritrova in un regno abitato da mostri giganteschi che vogliono conquistare la Terra, come accaduto tanti secoli prima quando l’intero pianeta era sotto il loro dominio. Quando i giganti, guidati dal perfido Fallon, rapiscono la principessa Isabelle, Jack non esita a unirsi alla truppe che dovranno liberarla, ponendo fine una volta per sempre all'atavica guerra. Spinto dall'amore, supererà le sue paure scoprendo doti e virtù nascoste.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Shrek", un film d'animazione con le allegre creature dal ciuffo ribelle. La principessa Poppy e il malinconico Branch devono salvare i Trolls dai loro mortali nemici.

programme.title: Hop
programme.desc: Quando Fred, investe accidentalmente il coniglio pasquale, non ha la minima idea di quello che dovrà sopportare nei giorni successivi. Per salvare la Pasqua, infatti, dovrà prendersi cura del coniglio e sostituirlo.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer 2
programme.desc: Sequel del capolavoro d'animazione Dreamworks. Il giovane vichingo Hiccup e il suo fedele amico Sdentato difendono il loro villaggio da un temibile drago rinnegato.

Poppy e Branch scoprono l'esistenza di sei diverse tribu' di Trolls, ognuna dedicata a un genere musicale: Pop, Funk, Musica classica, Techno, Country e Hard Rock. E proprio la tribu' dei rockettari, guidata da Re Trash (doppiato da Ozzy Osbourne nella versione originale) e dalla Regina Barb, ha elaborato il piu' cattivo dei propositi: regnare su tutti gli altri Trolls, eliminando gli altri generi musicali affinche' il rock regni. Poppy e Branch e tutti i loro amici si impegneranno per far prevalere l'armonia.

programme.desc: Ari Aster ("Hereditary") dirige Florence Pugh in un insolito horror alla luce del sole. In un villaggio svedese, una coppia di fidanzati viene coinvolta in sanguinari riti pagani.
